name: Gutter Cat Gang
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: An attacker has successfully compromised the Twitter accounts of popular NFT project Gutter Cat Gang and its co-founders, and used them to post phishing website airdrops claiming to be new NFTs. Instead of receiving the promised tokens, those who authorized contracted their wallets to be emptied. One victim lost 36 NFTs, including a Bored Ape NFT they bought for about $130,000. In total, the attackers managed to steal between $750,000 and $900,000 worth of NFTs, depending on how the resale value was estimated.
